syntactic_simplification: Mice are important in neuroscience research. Scientists use them to learn about how the brain works. Researchers often choose male mice for experiments. They do this because female mice have hormone cycles. These cycles can cause behavior changes. This can affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain research. Scientists use them to learn about how the brain works. Researchers often choose male mice for tests. They do this because female mice have hormone changes. These changes can cause different behaviors. This can affect the results of the tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are very important for studying the brain. Scientists use them to understand how the brain functions. Researchers usually pick male mice for their experiments. They do this because female mice go through hormone changes each month. These changes can make their behavior vary. Such variations might affect the results of the experiments.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts by rewriting them in Plain English. Use clear, descriptive and explanatory language. You can freely use the editing opertaions of adding, deleting and paraphrasing words, phrases and sentences.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important for studying the brain. Scientists use them to understand how the brain works. Researchers often choose male mice for experiments because female mice experience monthly hormone changes. These changes can lead to different behaviors, which might affect the results of the experiments.
